entities.name: Battle at Mors Ridge
entities.description: Time of Legends battle on Corondor in which the Elder Dragon Palladia-Mors was woken and put back to sleep.

entities.name: Ham, the Tickery Man
entities.description: Member of the High Council of Mors Ridge who maintained the 'tickery' spell; really Chromium Rhuell.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: Elder Dragon kept slumbering beneath Mors Ridge.

entities.name: Vaevictis Asmadi
entities.description: Palladia's cousin, cursed into a Dragon Whelp, who woke her; later vanished from the battle.

entities.name: Ad'Amra
entities.description: Human warrior spellcaster, daughter of Chromium and Red Donald, who loved 'Ham'.

entities.name: Piru
entities.description: Person whose death Chromium Rhuell is mourning.

events.summary: Vaevictis Asmadi wakes Palladia-Mors to lift the curse that made him a Dragon Whelp; she undoes the spell and they rampage with an army.
events.quote: Palladia's cousin Vaevictis Asmadi managed to wake her up

events.summary: Ham reveals himself as Palladia's brother Chromium Rhuell and convinces Vaevictis to turn on Palladia.
events.quote: The Tickery Man Ham then revealed himself to be Palladia's brother

events.summary: Palladia reverses one of Vaevictis's spells and he disappears from the battle, never seen again.
events.quote: he disappeared from the battle, never to be seen again

events.summary: Ad'Amra helps put the sleep-spell back on Palladia.
events.quote: managed to put the sleep-spell back on Palladia

relations.quote: revealed himself to be Palladia's brother

relations.note: She had fallen in love with 'Ham'.
